PROJECT_DUPLICATE_STEP_NUMBER_ACROSS_GRA: Step number {stepNumber} is used in several grafcets of the project: {grafcetNames}. Each step number must be unique across the whole project.
PROJECT_MISSING_ANALYSER_FOR_NOTATION: No analyser is available for the "{notation}" notation (program "{programName}"). This program was not analysed.
PROJECT_MISSING_MAIN: The project has no Main program.
PROJECT_MULTIPLE_MAINS: The project has {count} Main programs; it should have exactly one.
LADDER_NOT_REFERENCED: The "{ladderName}" ladder is not referenced by any block in the project: it will never run.
GRAFCET_TOO_FEW_STEPS: The grafcet must contain at least two steps.
GRAFCET_NO_INITIAL_STEP: The grafcet has no initial step.
GRAFCET_MULTIPLE_INITIAL_STEPS: The grafcet has {count} initial steps. Studomate currently supports only a single initial step (a tool limitation, not a GRAFCET rule).
GRAFCET_DISCONNECTED_COMPONENTS: The grafcet contains several disconnected networks (several separate cycles).
GRAFCET_CONNECTION_DANGLING_ELEMENT: A connection references a non-existent element ({elementType} "{elementId}").
GRAFCET_CONNECTION_INVALID_TYPE: Invalid connection between a "{sourceType}" element and a "{targetType}" element.
GRAFCET_UNREACHABLE_STEPS: Step(s) unreachable from the initial step: {stepNumbers}. This part of the grafcet will never activate.
GRAFCET_DEAD_END_STEPS: Step(s) with no path back to a cycle: {stepNumbers}. Once reached, the grafcet stays stuck there.
GRAFCET_STEP_VARIABLE_NAME_CONFLICT: Variable "{variableName}" conflicts with the automatically generated step variable of the same name.
GRAFCET_DUPLICATE_TIMER_NAME: Timer identifier "{timerName}" is used for several timers in this grafcet. Each timer must have a unique identifier within the grafcet.
STEP_NUMBER_MISSING: The step number is not set.
STEP_NUMBER_NOT_POSITIVE_INTEGER: The step number must be a non-negative integer.
STEP_NUMBER_DUPLICATE: Step number {stepNumber} is used by several steps.
STEP_NO_PREDECESSOR: The step has no upstream element.
STEP_NO_SUCCESSOR: The step has no downstream element.
STEP_MULTIPLE_SUCCESSORS: The step has several downstream elements. A sequence selection must go through an OR divergence.
TRANSITION_EMPTY_EXPRESSION: The transition has no expression. It can never be crossed.
TRANSITION_ASSIGNMENT_NOT_ALLOWED: Invalid expression: a transition cannot be an assignment.
TRANSITION_NUMERIC_CONSTANT_NOT_ALLOWED: A transition cannot be a numeric constant. If you want it to always be validated, use the boolean constant TRUE instead.
TRANSITION_EXPRESSION_NOT_BOOLEAN: Invalid expression: a transition must be an expression that returns a boolean.
TRANSITION_NO_PREDECESSOR: The transition has no upstream element.
TRANSITION_NO_SUCCESSOR: The transition has no downstream element.
TRANSITION_MULTIPLE_SUCCESSORS: A transition can have only one direct successor. Use an AND divergence to activate several steps simultaneously.
TRANSITION_MULTIPLE_PREDECESSORS: A transition can have only one direct predecessor. Use an AND convergence to synchronise several steps.
TRANSITION_NON_BOOLEAN_VARIABLE_REFERENC: The transition references variable "{variableName}", which is not boolean.
TRANSITION_TIMER_NAME_CONFLICT: Timer identifier "{timerName}" conflicts with an existing variable.
ACTION_BOOLEAN_MUST_BE_IDENTIFIER: A boolean action must be a plain reference to a variable.
ACTION_NUMERIC_MUST_BE_ASSIGNMENT: An action on a numeric variable must be an assignment (e.g. Var := X + Y).
ACTION_STRING_MUST_BE_ASSIGNMENT: An action on a string variable must be an assignment (e.g. Var := "Text").
ACTION_INCOMPATIBLE_EXECUTION_MODE: Execution mode "{executionMode}" is incompatible with action type "{actionType}".
ACTION_NOT_CONNECTED_TO_STEP: The action is not connected to any step.
ACTION_NUMERIC_TYPE_MISMATCH: The action is numeric but the assigned variable has an incompatible type ({actualType}).
ACTION_STRING_TYPE_MISMATCH: The action is a string but the assigned variable has an incompatible type ({actualType}).
ACTION_VARIABLE_IS_INPUT: The action cannot change variable "{variableName}" because it is an input variable.
ACTION_STEP_VARIABLE_READONLY: The action cannot change "{variableName}": it is an automatically generated, read-only step variable.
ACTION_SET_RESET_CONFLICT_SAME_STEP: This step carries both a SET and a RESET action on variable "{variableName}": contradictory behaviour within the same cycle.
JUNCTION_PIVOT_NOT_CONNECTED: The pivot is not connected to any element.
JUNCTION_BRANCH_NOT_CONNECTED: Some branches are not connected to any element.
JUNCTION_AND_CONVERGENCE_WITHOUT_DIVERGE: The AND convergence does not come from an AND divergence.
JUNCTION_AND_BRANCH_COUNT_MISMATCH: The number of branches of the AND divergence and of the AND convergence do not match.
JUNCTION_AND_DIVERGENCE_NOT_CLOSED: The AND divergence is not closed by an AND convergence.
JUNCTION_OR_MIN_BRANCHES: An OR junction must have at least two branches.
JUNCTION_OR_START_BRANCH_NOT_TRANSITION: An OR divergence must branch out to transitions.
JUNCTION_OR_END_BRANCH_NOT_TRANSITION: An OR convergence must come from transitions.
JUNCTION_OR_START_BRANCHES_NOT_EXCLUSIVE: The conditions of transitions "{expressionA}" and "{expressionB}" are not mutually exclusive: several branches of the OR divergence could be crossed at the same time.
STEP_REFERRAL_NUMBER_EMPTY: The referenced step number is empty: the link is not functional.
STEP_REFERRAL_NUMBER_NOT_POSITIVE_INTEGE: The step number must be a positive integer.
STEP_REFERRAL_REFERENCED_STEP_NOT_FOUND: No step with number {stepNumber} exists in the grafcet.
STEP_REFERRAL_SELF_REFERENCE: The referral cannot reference the step it directly depends on.
STEP_REFERRAL_NO_UPSTREAM_TENANT: No referral is directly linked to the source step (without a junction, for example).
STEP_REFERRAL_TENANT_NO_PREDECESSOR: The referral has no preceding step.
STEP_REFERRAL_TENANT_MULTIPLE_PREDECESSO: The referral has several preceding steps; the referenced source cannot be determined.
STEP_REFERRAL_SOURCE_MISMATCH: The referenced source step does not match the step linked to the referral.
LADDER_NETWORK_NO_COIL: This branch does not drive any coil.
LADDER_COIL_DUPLICATE_NORMAL_ASSIGNMENT: Variable "{variableName}" is driven by {count} separate normal coils.
LADDER_ELEMENT_NO_PREDECESSOR: This element is not linked to any previous element or to the power rail.
LADDER_COIL_VARIABLE_IS_INPUT: The coil cannot change variable "{variableName}" because it is an input variable.
LADDER_CONNECTION_INVALID_ORDER: A connection links an element to another one located in an earlier column.
BLOCK_PROGRAM_UNDECLARED: The program referenced by this block does not exist in the project.
BLOCK_PROGRAM_NOT_LADDER: The program "{programName}" referenced by this block is not a ladder.
BLOCK_PROGRAM_IS_MAIN: The program "{programName}" is the project Main: it cannot be called by a block.
BLOCK_PROGRAM_DUPLICATE_REFERENCE: The program "{programName}" is referenced by several blocks of this Main.
BLOCK_NAME_DUPLICATE: The name "{blockName}" of this block is already used by another block in the project.
BLOCK_NAME_VARIABLE_CONFLICT: The name "{blockName}" of this block conflicts with an existing variable of the same name.
BLOCK_TIMER_NAME_INVALID: The name "{blockName}" of this timer block is not valid.
BLOCK_TIMER_PT_EMPTY: The {pinName} parameter of this block must be filled in.
BLOCK_TIMER_PT_INVALID_CONSTANT: "{value}" is not a valid TIME constant (e.g. T#5s, T#1h30m).
BLOCK_TIMER_PT_UNDECLARED_VARIABLE: Variable "{variableName}" referenced by the {pinName} parameter of this block does not exist.
BLOCK_TIMER_PT_INVALID_TYPE: Variable "{variableName}" referenced by the {pinName} parameter of this block must be numeric or TIME.
BLOCK_TIMER_ET_UNDECLARED_VARIABLE: Variable "{variableName}" referenced by the {pinName} parameter of this block does not exist.
BLOCK_TIMER_ET_INVALID_TYPE: Variable "{variableName}" referenced by the {pinName} parameter of this block must be numeric or TIME.
BLOCK_COUNTER_NAME_INVALID: The name "{blockName}" of this block is not valid.
BLOCK_COUNTER_CONTROL_EMPTY: The reset/load parameter (R/LD) must be filled in.
BLOCK_COUNTER_CONTROL_UNDECLARED_VARIABL: Variable "{variableName}" referenced by the reset/load parameter (R/LD) does not exist.
BLOCK_COUNTER_CONTROL_INVALID_TYPE: Variable "{variableName}" referenced by the reset/load parameter (R/LD) must be boolean.
BLOCK_COUNTER_PV_EMPTY: The PV parameter of this block must be filled in.
BLOCK_COUNTER_PV_UNDECLARED_VARIABLE: Variable "{variableName}" referenced by the PV parameter of this block does not exist.
BLOCK_COUNTER_PV_INVALID_TYPE: Variable "{variableName}" referenced by the PV parameter of this block must be numeric.
BLOCK_COUNTER_CV_UNDECLARED_VARIABLE: Variable "{variableName}" referenced by the CV parameter of this block does not exist.
BLOCK_COUNTER_CV_INVALID_TYPE: Variable "{variableName}" referenced by the CV parameter of this block must be numeric.
BLOCK_COMPARE_IN1_EMPTY: The IN1 parameter must be filled in.
BLOCK_COMPARE_IN2_EMPTY: The IN2 parameter must be filled in.
BLOCK_COMPARE_OPERATOR_INVALID: "{operator}" is not a valid comparison operator.
BLOCK_COMPARE_INPUT_NOT_ALLOWED: The {pinName} parameter must contain a variable or a value, not a complex expression.
BLOCK_ASSIGN_IN_EMPTY: The IN parameter must be filled in.
BLOCK_ASSIGN_OUT_EMPTY: The OUT parameter must be filled in.
BLOCK_ASSIGN_IN_NOT_ALLOWED: The IN parameter must contain a variable or a value, not an expression.
BLOCK_ASSIGN_OUT_NOT_A_VARIABLE: The OUT parameter must be a variable mnemonic.
BLOCK_ARITHMETIC_IN1_EMPTY: The IN1 parameter must be filled in.
BLOCK_ARITHMETIC_IN2_EMPTY: The IN2 parameter must be filled in.
BLOCK_ARITHMETIC_OUT_EMPTY: The OUT parameter must be filled in.
BLOCK_ARITHMETIC_OPERATOR_INVALID: "{operator}" is not a valid arithmetic operator.
BLOCK_ARITHMETIC_INPUT_NOT_ALLOWED: The IN1 and IN2 parameters must contain a variable or a value, not an expression.
BLOCK_ARITHMETIC_OUT_NOT_A_VARIABLE: The OUT parameter must be a variable mnemonic.
